system.description:
You Stab your weapon through the air, creating shockwave after shockwave of force.

Select one point you can see within range, all creatures within 10ft of it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapons damage] + 2d12 damage and having their AC reduced by 2 on a failed save, half as much damage on a success.

Chain 2: A creature that failed their saving throw cannot maintain concentration on Jutsu until the end of their next turn.

Chain 3: You strike out and twirl your weapon defensively immediately after. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain +6 DR.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank above A-rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d12.
